post.meaning: Beloved, let us love one another, for love is from God; everyone who loves is born of God and knows God.
post.caption:
Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.

हे प्रियो, हम आपस में प्रेम रखें, क्योंकि प्रेम परमेश्वर से है; जो कोई प्रेम करता है, वह परमेश्वर से जन्मा है और परमेश्वर को जानता है।

Beloved, let us love one another, for love is from God; everyone who loves is born of God and knows God.

— 1 John (KJV), 4:7

reel.meaning: God has no favourites. But whoever draws near in love finds that God was already within.
reel.caption:
समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः।
ये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या मयि ते तेषु चाप्यहम्॥

ईश्वर किसी का पक्ष नहीं लेता; पर जो प्रेम से उसकी ओर बढ़ता है, वह उसे अपने भीतर पाता है।

God has no favourites. But whoever draws near in love finds that God was already within.

— Bhagavad Gita, 9.29
